title: Six Boxes
lines: Nell went to help Gran out in the shed.
They packed six big boxes with tape and rags.
One box had dishes. One had glasses.
One had ripe peaches from the tree.
The rest had brushes, socks, and cups.
All six boxes had the same red lid.
Gran sat down and said, "Get me the peaches."
Nell lifted a lid. Dishes! Not peaches.
She lifted the next lid. Just brushes.
Six lids up and down. Nell got mixed up.
"I know," said Nell. "I have a plan."
She ran and got a pen from the shelf.
She made a mark on each of the lids.
A dish, a cup, a peach, and a brush.
Now Nell can find the peaches at once.
She lifted that lid and got them out.
Gran said, "That was a smart plan, Nell."
They sat down and ate a ripe peach.

questions.ask: Why could Nell not find the peaches?
questions.listenFor: All six boxes had the same red lid. Have them find that line.
She got a pen and made a mark on each lid — a dish, a cup, a peach, a brush.

questions.ask: What mark would you put on a box of cups? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Listen for a reason — it has to be quick to spot.
